steps.note: Keyboard-only equivalent of dragging the vertical scrollbar thumb / clicking its track (quadraui#828): Home/End (and j/k/PageUp/PageDown for finer steps) reach every scroll position with no mouse step anywhere in this scenario. Compare table.scroll_under_cursor, the same range covered by mouse wheel.
Scrolling back the same distance restores the original view — the keyboard path is symmetric, not a one-way ratchet, matching the mouse wheel's own round-trip.
